_rawColorNote: Single-file arms define their tokens in :root/[data-theme] blocks inside the HTML; raw hexes are legal ONLY inside those token definitions. The soft raw-color walk stays informative; per-arm contrast is HARD-gated from each arm's embedded #token-contract (check-token-contracts.mjs) and per-arm static-gates profiles under gates/.
_register: calm, factual, outdoors-trust; zero marketing voice. A hiker at the trailhead parking lot answers 'can I hike today, and where' inside 30 seconds. Statuses keep one stable meaning everywhere; unknown is rendered as unknown, never dressed up; nothing playful is mandatory; no urgency theater, no marketing adjectives.
_northStars: NOAA point forecast pages — data plainness that earns trust; Swiss federal railway departure boards — glanceable status discipline; a national park paper trailhead notice — the register made physical.
_notes: E1 validation run project (sealed brief). Content authority: data/trail-status.json + injected constants in data/derived.json only. Three tournament arms under arms/<name>/index.html, each with its own embedded token contract.
